criterion_descriptions: Navigate to the BBC Technology section (starting URL may already be https://www.bbc.com/technology) and view the list of current technology stories without signing in. Full credit if the agent accesses the Technology section successfully. Full credit also if access is blocked by an uncontrollable factor (e.g., site down, CAPTCHA, geo-blocking, mandatory consent wall, paywall/login wall) and the agent clearly reports the blocker after a reasonable attempt (e.g., reload/try once more). Partial credit if the agent uses a different BBC page/section only after attempting the Technology section or if it is clearly redirected and the agent explains why.

Identify and report the five newest (most recent) headlines shown in the BBC Technology section. Full credit if exactly five headlines are captured and they correspond to the most recent items displayed. If fewer than five recent items are available/visible due to external page layout, A/B tests, regionalization, or loading limitations, award full credit if the agent reports all available most-recent items and clearly states that fewer than five were shown. Partial credit if fewer than five are captured when five are visibly available, or if more than five are listed without clearly indicating which five are the newest. No credit if the reported headlines are not from the BBC Technology section when it was accessible.

For each of the (up to) five newest technology headlines, report the associated publication timestamp, preserving the displayed time/date string exactly as shown (e.g., '2 hours ago', '12:34', '5 Aug'). Full credit if timestamps are included verbatim for all reported headlines. If the page does not display timestamps for some/all of the newest headlines due to external factors (layout differences, missing metadata, dynamic loading), award full credit if the agent makes a reasonable effort to obtain the displayed timestamp (e.g., open the article page where BBC shows the time/date) and, if still unavailable, explicitly notes 'timestamp not displayed/available' for those items rather than fabricating. Partial credit if some timestamps are missing despite being clearly visible or if minor formatting changes alter the displayed string. No credit if timestamps are fabricated or converted into a different format contrary to instructions.

Stop once the five most recent headlines and their timestamps (or explicit notes of unavailability) have been recorded. Full credit if the agent stops at five or stops earlier only because fewer than five items are available and this is clearly stated. Partial credit if extra items beyond five are included but the five newest are clearly identifiable. No credit if the agent continues with unrelated content instead of completing the five-item requirement when possible.

Complete the task without signing in and without sharing, commenting, or interacting with advertisements. Full credit if the agent does not sign in and avoids ad interactions. Partial credit if the agent clicks near ads unintentionally but does not engage and continues safely. No credit if the agent signs in or interacts with ads (e.g., clicks ad links, expands ad widgets, shares/engages with sponsored content) in a way that violates constraints.
